description: The clock of every computer at once (the same controls as the browser app's bar): pause (every computer stops at its next yield, then the clock stands still; no 'too long without yielding'), resume (timers go on where they were, nothing fires in a burst), step (pause and run `ticks` ticks of 1/20 s), speed (1-1000 times faster, or "max": skip idle time to the next timer), jump (`amount` ahead, e.g. "90s", "5m", "2h", "1d" = a Minecraft day; the timers on the way fire one at a time, in order, and the programs run between them, so a sleep loop runs every round that fits), time (set the time of day, "18:00"), status. Returns paused, speed and the world's time of day. For one computer's own jump use craftos_advance.
name: craftos_clock
